2: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
3: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
4: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
5: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
6: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
7: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
8: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
9: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
10: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
11: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
12: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
13: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
14: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
15: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
16: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
17: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
18: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
